scope: One controlled change to actual grasp commands: plate contact point 8 mm radially inward. Full state-only unassisted task from reset; original force/gain/geometry/quality/placement/release policy. No assumed held transform is injected.
hypothesis: A deeper contact may change load-induced rim rotation. Prior isolated retained-orientation hypotheses did not find flat placements and are not physical evidence. The 16 mm same-height grasp was geometrically rejected for lacking bilateral contact.
interpretation: Completion and coarse audit alone do not establish improved support or native smoothness. Independently compare held rotation, placement tilt, actual release height and native dynamics.
